title: layout.json of nimblescape Markdown Paper
description: The file layout.json of a layout folder, in the format nimblescape-layout 1.x. The whole format: npx -y @nimblescape/markdownpaper instructions layout, or docs/layout.md of nimblescape/markdownpaper-vscode.

$schema.description: The address of this schema, for the editor.

format.description: The format and its version, for example "nimblescape-layout 1.0.0".

instructions.description: The command that prints the rules of the format, for agents. Informative.

name.description: The name of the layout for people. Default: the name of the folder.

language.description: The language of the documents, a tag such as de-AT or en-US. It decides the hyphenation and the words of the special sections. Default: en-US.

citationStyle.description: The citation style: the built-in style apa7, or a .csl file of the layout folder. Default: apa7.

stylesheets.description: The style sheets, in their order, relative to the layout folder. Default: ["page.css"].

before.description: The templates of the fixed pages before the text, in their order.

after.description: The templates of the fixed pages after the text, in their order.

document.description: The empty paper document: the Markdown file that starts a new document of the layout, with the values of the cover page in its front matter and the files that it links to in the layout folder.

preview.description: The PDF of the empty paper document, which shows the pages of the layout before a person chooses it.

origin.description: Only in a copy of a layout on GitHub in a project: where it comes from. A new project writes it, and markdownpaper update and "Update Layout" read it to update the copy from its repository.

layout.description: The name of the layout on GitHub: github:<owner>/<repository>/<folder>.

ref.description: The branch, the tag or the commit that the copy follows.

commit.description: The commit of the copied files, 40 hexadecimal digits.

fields.description: The fields of the front matter, by name: each a description, or an object.

description.description: What the field holds, for the hover of the editor and for the agents that write documents.

required.description: true: a document of the layout must have the field.

default.description: The value when the document has none. With values, one of them.

values.description: A parameter of the layout: the names that the author chooses from, for example the variants of the layout. The style sheets read the choice from the attribute data-field-<field>.

numbered.description: false: the renderer numbers no heading. Default: true.

depth.description: The deepest level of a numbered heading. Default: 3.

unnumbered.description: Regular expressions; a heading whose text matches one gets no number, nor do the headings below it.

numberedSections.description: The codes of the special sections whose headings get a number as other chapters do, for example ["BIB"]. Default: [].

depth.description: The deepest level of a heading in the table of contents. Default: 3.

front.description: false: the table of contents lists no chapter of the front part (affidavit, abstract, foreword, table of contents and lists before the first chapter). Default: true.

hyphenate.description: false: no soft hyphens. Default: true.
true: the reference list gets soft hyphens as the text does, but not its web addresses. Default: false.

lineNumbers.description: true: the number of each line before the code of a listing. Default: false.

pdfName.description: The name of the PDF file without .pdf, with fields as {{field}}; {{file}} is the name of the Markdown file. Default: "{{file}}".

terms.description: Words of the language that this layout changes: the headings of the special sections by their code, and the words figure, table, listing and appendix.
